adult_characters.framing: Focus exclusively on hands, torso, lower body, or back view. Crop and frame out heads, faces, and eyes completely (Tom and Jerry style framing).
adult_characters.negative_prompts: adult face, eyes, full head, face features, headshot, front portrait

child_characters.facial_rule: The facial area must feature a blank soft glowing white light surface or blur effect, completely concealing eyes, nose, and mouth features.
child_characters.negative_prompts: detailed child eyes, mouth, nose, detailed facial features

audio.audio_type: Pure vocal voiceover and natural ambient sounds only. Strictly zero background music or musical instruments.

global_negative_prompts: face, eyes, detailed face, portrait, realistic head, music, background instrumentals, musical notes, idol, statue
